sloka: श्रुतिस्तु खल्वियं सत्या लौकिकी प्रतिभाति मा ।यदन्न: पुरुषो भवति तदन्नास्तस्य देवता: ॥ २.१०३.१५॥
transliteration: śrutistu khalviyaṁ satyā laukikī pratibhāti mā ।yadanna: puruṣo bhavati tadannāstasya devatā: ॥ 2.103.15॥

translations.english: The wellknown saying in this world is that 'whatever food a man partakes, his gods also partake the same'. This dictum appears true (now).
